screen.name: Home
screen.purpose: Main overview screen displaying the user's recent content and providing quick access to primary application areas.

syncStatusBanner.title: Signed in, not synced
syncStatusBanner.body: Your changes will sync when connection is available.

mobile.categoryNavigation: Two flexible tabs and a fixed-width selector in one row. No horizontal scrolling. Active, To do, Waiting and Notes stay fully visible at 320px and wider.

visualRules: Use global design tokens from design-system.json.
Do not define screen-specific colors.
Do not define screen-specific border radii.
Do not define arbitrary spacing values.
The reference PNG is a visual target, not a source of token values. Do not measure colors, spacing, or radii from it.
Media should remain the strongest visual element inside media cards.
Cards may have different heights depending on their content.
Do not force masonry cards to equal heights.
The create action must remain visually dominant.
The Home navigation item must use the global active navigation state.
FAB add and bottom navigation use Material Symbols Rounded: add, home, calendar_month, sell.
Header actions use Material Symbols Rounded: search, more_vert. Avatar fallback is the user initial, not an icon.
The avatar sits on the top-right, aligned with the page title. Search and more_vert sit below the avatar, not in the title row.
Signed-in-not-synced uses the status banner (person, warning, sync), never the legacy no-synchronize.png header icon.
Do not mix Material Symbols with legacy PNG icons on Home. Do not show no-connection.png or no-synchronize.png.
Bottom navigation destinations are Home, Tasks and Tags only. Do not add Settings as a fourth tab.
The avatar opens the account menu: Profile, Settings, Integrations, Sign out.
The leading icon on every Home card comes from the task conditions: location_on, then calendar_month, otherwise radio_button_unchecked. Notes cards use article.
Do not print TODO, TIMER, SCHEDULE or LOCATION as text on the card.
Presence of an image does not change the leading icon.
Current live type is TODO (ETaskType.Basic) using radio_button_unchecked. Do not use check or check_circle.
The card overflow menu is Edit, Duplicate, Add to tags and Delete. Duplicate and Add to tags are visible but disabled until those features exist.
Place the category navigation immediately under the Home header and above the optional sync banner.
The row shows two category tabs and one compact selector. Active is always the first tab. To do is the default second tab. Waiting and Notes replace the second tab through the selector.
The selected tab uses the segmentedControl selected treatment: dark selected surface, thin teal outline and a teal icon. The unselected tab uses a subtle default border and stays in the same row.

The selector is a compact button in that row, with keyboard_arrow_down. It stays neutral when closed and uses the accent border while open. Its menu is the existing context menu, anchored to the button and aligned to the button's right edge.
Active uses play_arrow at the segmentedControl filled-icon exception. To do, Waiting and Notes stay outline icons. Waiting uses hourglass_empty from icons.homeContentMode.
Each visible tab shows an icon, a label and a count. Counts update from live data. Do not truncate Active, To do, Waiting or Notes at supported mobile widths, and do not scroll the row horizontally.

The selector menu lists the secondary categories that are not the current second tab, each with its category icon, label, and count. The selector button shows the sum of those hidden counts. Active is never in the menu. Choosing one replaces the second tab, activates it, updates the task list and closes the menu.
Choosing Active activates Active and leaves the second tab unchanged. Choosing the visible second tab activates that category.

The selected secondary category and the active category survive ordinary in-app navigation, including Task View, Create and Edit. A full application restart may return the second tab to To do. Do not persist this preference in storage.

Pinned tags are a headerless row of compact wrapping chips directly below the category navigation and above the sync banner. Do not add a heading, helper label, pin icon, section background, or divider.

Pinned tags appear as chips. A tag selected on the Tags page also appears here, selected, even when it is not pinned. Several tags can be selected. A task matches when it has any selected tag. Tapping a chip again clears that tag. Changing Active, To do, Waiting or Notes keeps the selection.

The tag filter narrows every category. Tab counts, the selector total, and the header count are the tasks that match the selected tags. A category with no matching tasks uses that category's existing empty state.

Each chip is a 22px capsule: 8px horizontal padding, a 4px gap, a 12px sell icon in the tag color and a 12px/500 label. The ends stay fully rounded. Unselected chips are transparent with the default border and primary text. Selected chips keep that tag-colored icon and use the segmentedControl selected treatment: dark selected surface and a 1px teal border. Do not replace the teal selection border with the tag color, and do not use a solid teal fill, an 8px or 12px radius, or a percentage radius.
Switching modes filters the existing two-column masonry grid without changing bottom navigation.
A horizontal swipe on the content moves one mode. Active, To do, Waiting and Notes stay in that order. Landing on To do, Waiting or Notes replaces the second tab with that category.
The header count names the selected mode: "3 active items", "8 to do items", "2 waiting items", "12 notes".

Tab counts, the selector total, the menu counts, and the header count use the same set: tasks in that mode that match the selected tags and the search query. An empty query and no selected tags count every item in the mode.
Done and Cancel stay off Home. Home is the working set: Active, To do, Waiting and Notes.

Active is status Active. Notes is status Notes. To do is status Todo with a todo condition. Waiting is status Todo with a calendar or location condition. A task with both a todo condition and a trigger is listed in To do and Waiting.
Task cards retain their task-type icons; Notes cards use Material Symbols Rounded article.

Use Google Material Symbols Rounded article for the Notes tab, with FILL 0, weight 400, optical size 24. Do not use notes, subject, menu, or a generic list icon. Render the exact Material Symbol, not a Lucide or custom SVG substitute.
The attached Home mockup is a visual reference for the segmented control, not a literal data contract: sample cards shown there do not override filtering rules.
When the selected mode count is 0, replace the masonry grid with that mode's empty state. The header, segmented switcher, sync banner, floating create action and bottom navigation stay.
Emptiness follows the selected mode count, not the total number of tasks. Switching Active, To do, Waiting or Notes changes both the mascot and the copy.
A search that hides cards does not show the empty state while that mode's count is still greater than 0.
At zero the header still names the mode: "0 active items", "0 to do items", "0 waiting items", "0 notes".
The empty state has no button of its own. The floating create action is the only create control on Home.
The mascot is a small centered illustration. Keep the surrounding area empty. Do not add confetti, a large scene, or a second accent color.

activeSelected.description: Default state: Active tab highlighted in teal, To do in the second tab, selector closed; masonry shows only Active tasks.

todoSelected.description: To do is the second tab and is highlighted in teal; grid displays To do tasks.

notesSelected.description: Notes has replaced To do as the second tab and is highlighted in teal; grid displays Notes cards.

activeEmpty.description: Active count is 0. The bored mascot replaces the grid. Header, switcher, sync banner, floating create action and bottom navigation stay.

todoEmpty.description: To do count is 0. The puzzled mascot replaces the grid. The rest of the screen chrome stays.

notesEmpty.description: Notes count is 0. The waiting mascot replaces the grid. The rest of the screen chrome stays.

categoryMenuOpen.description: The category selector is expanded. The menu is anchored to the selector, aligned to its right edge, and lists the secondary categories that are not the current second tab. Active is not listed.

reference.description: Home with Active and To do category tabs plus a category selector (Active selected by default), sync banner, two-column masonry, FAB and Home/Tasks/Tags bottom navigation.

layout.tabs: two flexible tabs sharing the remaining width

menu.contains: secondary categories except the one currently shown in the second tab

behavior.selectingSecondary: Replaces the second tab, activates that category, updates the task list and closes the menu.
behavior.selectingActive: Activates Active and leaves the second tab unchanged.
behavior.selectingVisibleSecondary: Activates that category and leaves the second tab unchanged.
behavior.preserveAcrossNavigation: The active category and the selected secondary category survive returning from Task View, Create and Edit.
behavior.restart: A full application restart may reset the second tab to To do. Do not add storage only for this preference.
behavior.countSemantics: Counts reflect all items in each mode, not only visible grid cards. Visible tabs show their counts. The empty state appears only when the selected mode count is 0.

visual.layout: two flexible tabs and one compact selector in one row
visual.selectedTreatment: subtle dark teal background with thin teal outline
visual.unselectedTreatment: default surface with a subtle border, muted text and icons
visual.selectorClosed: neutral, same surface and border as an unselected tab
visual.countBadge: small separate rounded badge from segmentedControl.countBadge
prohibited: four labels in one scrolling row
truncated category labels at 320px and wider

active.scene: Sitting at a laptop, with a faint sigh. The smile is a crooked line and one letter is slightly tilted.
active.title: Nothing active right now.
active.body: Pick a task from your to do list or create a new one to get started.

todo.scene: Looking at an empty list, with a question mark beside it.
todo.title: Your to-do list is empty.
todo.body: Add a new task, capture an idea or move something from notes.

waiting.scene: Reuses the to-do empty illustration until a dedicated waiting scene is approved.
waiting.title: Nothing is waiting.
waiting.body: Tasks with a calendar or location condition show up here until they start.

notes.scene: Resting on a stack of notes, with a thought bubble overhead.
notes.title: No notes yet.
notes.body: Capture ideas, links, images or anything you want to remember for later.

pinnedTagFilters.placement: directly below the category navigation and above the sync banner
pinnedTagFilters.heading: none
pinnedTagFilters.visibleWhen: at least one tag is pinned
pinnedTagFilters.hiddenWhenEmpty: Render nothing. Keep the category navigation's normal bottom spacing.

behavior.select: Filter the current Home category to tasks that include this tag. Category counts stay unfiltered.
behavior.openFromTagsPage: Show Home with that tag selected, including a tag that is not pinned.
behavior.emptyMatch: Show the current category empty state. The header count still names every item in the category.

visual.layout: wrap to additional rows, no horizontal scrolling
visual.selectedTreatment: surface.selected, 1px accent border, active icon, primary text
visual.unselectedTreatment: transparent, default border, default icon, primary text
prohibited: pin icon on the Home chip
section background, divider, or extra heading
adding pinned tags to the Active / To do / Waiting / Notes selector

angular.note: The live Home screen does not yet match this spec. Treat this JSON as the approved target, not a description of the current implementation. Bottom-nav destinations /tasks and /tags are product destinations from the approved design; they are not a claim that those Angular routes already exist. The category tabs filter ETaskStatus.Active, ETaskStatus.Todo and ETaskStatus.Notes. Waiting is Todo with a calendar or location condition. Done and Cancel stay off Home. An empty selected mode shows that mode's mascot empty state instead of the grid and does not add a second create button.
